{{Quote|We ran into some kind of field-distortion effect, produced by the energy mining, I'll bet. It wiped out our on-board instrumentation.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
'''Energy mining''' was a form of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] that utilized [[energy drill]]s to disintegrate a target area with [[plasma]] bolts. The process produced residual energy that dissipated into a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in the form of lightning unless properly shielded. Debris around the mining area was also subject to [[Radiation/Legends|irradiation]].

Because of the fallout, energy mining was forbidden by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] law on any [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a native population. The Empire was known to violate this law in secret, as they did on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
